verses.original: Παῦλος καὶ Τιμόθεος δοῦλοι Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ Πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τοῖς οὖσιν ἐν Φιλίπποις σὺν ἐπισκόποις καὶ διακόνοις
verses.transliteration: Paulos kai Timotheos douloi Christou Iēsou Pasin tois hagiois en Christō Iēsou tois ousin en Philippois syn episkopois kai diakonois
verses.literal: Paul and Timothy servants of Christ Jesus To all the saints in Christ Jesus - at Philippi together with the overseers and deacons

verses.original: Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Charis hymin kai eirēnē apo Theou Patros hēmōn kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ Θεῷ μου ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ μνείᾳ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Eucharistō tō Theō mou epi pasē tē mneia hymōn
verses.literal: I thank my God every time I remember you

verses.original: πάντοτε ἐν πάσῃ δεήσει μου ὑπὲρ πάντων ὑμῶν μετὰ χαρᾶς τὴν δέησιν ποιούμενος
verses.transliteration: pantote en pasē deēsei mou hyper pantōn hymōn meta charas tēn deēsin poioumenos
verses.literal: In every prayer for all of you I always pray with joy

verses.original: ἐπὶ τῇ κοινωνίᾳ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἀπὸ τῆς πρώτης ἡμέρας ἄχρι τοῦ νῦν
verses.transliteration: epi tē koinōnia hymōn eis to euangelion apo tēs prōtēs hēmeras achri tou nyn
verses.literal: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now

verses.original: πεποιθὼς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ὅτι ὁ ἐναρξάμενος ἐν ὑμῖν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἐπιτελέσει ἄχρι ἡμέρας Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: pepoithōs auto touto hoti ho enarxamenos en hymin ergon agathon epitelesei achri hēmeras Christou Iēsou
verses.literal: being confident of this . . . that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus

verses.original: Καθώς ἐστιν δίκαιον ἐμοὶ τοῦτο φρονεῖν ὑπὲρ πάντων ὑμῶν διὰ τὸ ἔχειν με ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμᾶς ἔν τε τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀπολογίᾳ καὶ βεβαιώσει τοῦ εὐαγγελίου συνκοινωνούς μου τῆς χάριτος πάντας ὑμᾶς ὄντας
verses.transliteration: Kathōs estin dikaion emoi touto phronein hyper pantōn hymōn dia to echein me en tē kardia hymas en te tois desmois mou kai en tē apologia kai bebaiōsei tou euangeliou synkoinōnous mou tēs charitos pantas hymas ontas
verses.literal: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you since I have you in my heart For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel you are all partners in grace with me

verses.original: μάρτυς γάρ μου ὁ Θεός ὡς ἐπιποθῶ πάντας ὑμᾶς ἐν σπλάγχνοις Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: martys gar mou ho Theos hōs epipothō pantas hymas en splanchnois Christou Iēsou
verses.literal: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus

verses.original: Καὶ τοῦτο προσεύχομαι ἵνα ἡ ἀγάπη ὑμῶν ἔτι μᾶλλον καὶ μᾶλλον περισσεύῃ ἐν ἐπιγνώσει καὶ πάσῃ αἰσθήσει
verses.transliteration: Kai touto proseuchomai hina hē agapē hymōn eti mallon kai mallon perisseuē en epignōsei kai pasē aisthēsei
verses.literal: And this is my prayer that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight

verses.original: εἰς τὸ δοκιμάζειν ὑμᾶς τὰ διαφέροντα ἵνα ἦτε εἰλικρινεῖς καὶ ἀπρόσκοποι εἰς ἡμέραν Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: eis to dokimazein hymas ta diapheronta hina ēte eilikrineis kai aproskopoi eis hēmeran Christou
verses.literal: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ

verses.original: πεπληρωμένοι καρπὸν δικαιοσύνης τὸν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς δόξαν καὶ ἔπαινον Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: peplērōmenoi karpon dikaiosynēs ton dia Iēsou Christou eis doxan kai epainon Theou
verses.literal: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ to the glory and praise of God

verses.original: Γινώσκειν δὲ ὑμᾶς βούλομαι ἀδελφοί ὅτι τὰ κατ’ ἐμὲ μᾶλλον εἰς προκοπὴν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ἐλήλυθεν
verses.transliteration: Ginōskein de hymas boulomai adelphoi hoti ta kat’ eme mallon eis prokopēn tou euangeliou elēlythen
verses.literal: Now I want you to know brothers that my circumstances . . . . . . have actually served to advance the gospel

verses.original: ὥστε τοὺς δεσμούς μου φανεροὺς ἐν Χριστῷ γενέσθαι ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ πραιτωρίῳ καὶ τοῖς λοιποῖς πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: hōste tous desmous mou phanerous en Christō genesthai en holō tō praitōriō kai tois loipois pasin
verses.literal: As a result it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ

verses.original: καὶ τοὺς πλείονας τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἐν Κυρίῳ πεποιθότας τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου περισσοτέρως τολμᾶν ἀφόβως τὸν λόγον λαλεῖν
verses.transliteration: kai tous pleionas tōn adelphōn en Kyriō pepoithotas tois desmois mou perissoterōs tolman aphobōs ton logon lalein
verses.literal: And most of the brothers confident in the Lord by my chains now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear

verses.original: Τινὲς μὲν καὶ διὰ φθόνον καὶ ἔριν τινὲς δὲ καὶ δι’ εὐδοκίαν τὸν Χριστὸν κηρύσσουσιν
verses.transliteration: Tines men kai dia phthonon kai erin tines de kai di’ eudokian ton Christon kēryssousin
verses.literal: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry but others out of goodwill

verses.original: οἱ μὲν ἐξ ἀγάπης εἰδότες ὅτι εἰς ἀπολογίαν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου κεῖμαι
verses.transliteration: hoi men ex agapēs eidotes hoti eis apologian tou euangeliou keimai
verses.literal: The latter do so in love knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἐξ ἐριθείας τὸν Χριστὸν καταγγέλλουσιν οὐχ ἁγνῶς οἰόμενοι θλῖψιν ἐγείρειν τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου
verses.transliteration: hoi de ex eritheias ton Christon katangellousin ouch hagnōs oiomenoi thlipsin egeirein tois desmois mou
verses.literal: The former however preach . . . Christ out of selfish ambition not sincerely supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains

verses.original: Τί γάρ πλὴν ὅτι παντὶ τρόπῳ εἴτε προφάσει εἴτε ἀληθείᾳ Χριστὸς καταγγέλλεται καὶ ἐν τούτῳ χαίρω ἀλλὰ καὶ χαρήσομαι
verses.transliteration: Ti gar plēn hoti panti tropō eite prophasei eite alētheia Christos katangelletai kai en toutō chairō alla kai charēsomai
verses.literal: What then is the issue Just this that in every way whether by false motives or true Christ is preached And in this I rejoice Yes and I will continue to rejoice

verses.original: οἶδα γὰρ ὅτι τοῦτό μοι ἀποβήσεται εἰς σωτηρίαν διὰ τῆς ὑμῶν δεήσεως καὶ ἐπιχορηγίας τοῦ Πνεύματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: oida gar hoti touto moi apobēsetai eis sōtērian dia tēs hymōn deēseōs kai epichorēgias tou Pneumatos Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ my distress will turn out for my . . . deliverance

verses.original: κατὰ τὴν ἀποκαραδοκίαν καὶ ἐλπίδα μου ὅτι ἐν οὐδενὶ αἰσχυνθήσομαι ἀλλ’ ἐν πάσῃ παρρησίᾳ ὡς πάντοτε καὶ νῦν μεγαλυνθήσεται Χριστὸς ἐν τῷ σώματί μου εἴτε διὰ ζωῆς εἴτε διὰ θανάτου
verses.transliteration: kata tēn apokaradokian kai elpida mou hoti en oudeni aischynthēsomai all’ en pasē parrēsia hōs pantote kai nyn megalynthēsetai Christos en tō sōmati mou eite dia zōēs eite dia thanatou
verses.literal: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed . . . . . . but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body whether by life or by death

verses.original: Ἐμοὶ γὰρ τὸ ζῆν Χριστὸς καὶ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν κέρδος
verses.transliteration: Emoi gar to zēn Christos kai to apothanein kerdos
verses.literal: For to me to live is Christ and to die is gain

verses.original: εἰ δὲ τὸ ζῆν ἐν σαρκί τοῦτό μοι καρπὸς ἔργου καὶ τί αἱρήσομαι οὐ γνωρίζω
verses.transliteration: ei de to zēn en sarki touto moi karpos ergou kai ti hairēsomai ou gnōrizō
verses.literal: But if I go on living in the body this will mean fruitful labor for me So what shall I choose I do not know

verses.original: συνέχομαι δὲ ἐκ τῶν δύο τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν ἔχων εἰς τὸ ἀναλῦσαι καὶ σὺν Χριστῷ εἶναι πολλῷ γὰρ μᾶλλον κρεῖσσον
verses.transliteration: synechomai de ek tōn dyo tēn epithymian echōn eis to analysai kai syn Christō einai pollō gar mallon kreisson
verses.literal: I am torn between the two I desire to depart and be with Christ which is far . . . better indeed

verses.original: τὸ δὲ ἐπιμένειν ἐν τῇ σαρκὶ ἀναγκαιότερον δι’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: to de epimenein en tē sarki anankaioteron di’ hymas
verses.literal: But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body

verses.original: Καὶ τοῦτο πεποιθὼς οἶδα ὅτι μενῶ καὶ παραμενῶ πᾶσιν ὑμῖν εἰς τὴν ὑμῶν προκοπὴν καὶ χαρὰν τῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: Kai touto pepoithōs oida hoti menō kai paramenō pasin hymin eis tēn hymōn prokopēn kai charan tēs pisteōs
verses.literal: Convinced of this I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith

verses.original: ἵνα τὸ καύχημα ὑμῶν περισσεύῃ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ διὰ τῆς ἐμῆς παρουσίας πάλιν πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: hina to kauchēma hymōn perisseuē en Christō Iēsou en emoi dia tēs emēs parousias palin pros hymas
verses.literal: so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me

verses.original: Μόνον ἀξίως τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τοῦ Χριστοῦ πολιτεύεσθε ἵνα εἴτε ἐλθὼν καὶ ἰδὼν ὑμᾶς εἴτε ἀπὼν ἀκούω τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν ὅτι στήκετε ἐν ἑνὶ πνεύματι μιᾷ ψυχῇ συναθλοῦντες τῇ πίστει τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: Monon axiōs tou euangeliou tou Christou politeuesthe hina eite elthōn kai idōn hymas eite apōn akouō ta peri hymōn hoti stēkete en heni pneumati mia psychē synathlountes tē pistei tou euangeliou
verses.literal: Nevertheless conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ Then whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence I will know that you stand firm in one spirit contending together as one . . . for the faith of the gospel

verses.original: καὶ μὴ πτυρόμενοι ἐν μηδενὶ ὑπὸ τῶν ἀντικειμένων ἥτις ἐστὶν αὐτοῖς ἔνδειξις ἀπωλείας ὑμῶν δὲ σωτηρίας καὶ τοῦτο ἀπὸ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai mē ptyromenoi en mēdeni hypo tōn antikeimenōn hētis estin autois endeixis apōleias hymōn de sōtērias kai touto apo Theou
verses.literal: without being frightened . . . in any way by those who oppose you This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation and it is from God

verses.original: ὅτι ὑμῖν ἐχαρίσθη τὸ ὑπὲρ Χριστοῦ οὐ μόνον τὸ εἰς αὐτὸν πιστεύειν ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸ ὑπὲρ αὐτοῦ πάσχειν
verses.transliteration: hoti hymin echaristhē to hyper Christou ou monon to eis auton pisteuein alla kai to hyper autou paschein
verses.literal: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him but also to suffer for Him

verses.original: τὸν αὐτὸν ἀγῶνα ἔχοντες οἷον εἴδετε ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ νῦν ἀκούετε ἐν ἐμοί
verses.transliteration: ton auton agōna echontes hoion eidete en emoi kai nyn akouete en emoi
verses.literal: since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had and now hear that I still have . . .
